kahan_sum(const std::vector<T>& data) {\n    T sum = 0.0;\n    T c = 0.0;\n    for (const auto& val : data) {\n        T y = val - c;\n        T t = sum + y;\n        c = (t - sum) - y;\n        sum = t;\n    }\n    return sum;\n}\n\n// Print results for floating-point arrays\ntemplate <typename T>\nvoid print_results(const std::vector<T>& data, const char* name = \"Result\") {\n    if  }\n\n    const size_t N = data.size();\n    \n    // Compute statistics\n    T sum = kahan_sum(data);\n    T min_val = data[0];\n    T max_val = data[0];\n    for (const auto& val : data) {\n        min_val = std::min(min_val, val);\n        max_val = std::max(max_val, val);\n    }\n    \n    // Compute hash\n    hash h;\n    for (const auto& val : data) {\n        h.add(val);\n    }\n    \n    // Sample indices: 0, N/4, N/2, 3N/4, N-1\n    size_t indices[5] = {0, N/4, N/2, 3*N/4, N-1};\n    \n    printf(\"=== RESULTS ===\\n\");\n    printf(\"Name: %s\\n\", name);\n    printf(\"Elements: %zu\\n\", N);\n    printf(\"Sum: %.17e\\n\", static_cast<double>(sum));\n    printf(\"Min: %.17e\\n\", static_cast<double>(min_val));\n    printf(\"Max: %.17e\\n\", static_cast<double>(max_val));\n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011CgZKa1bCNDXnXtpL4VJTz","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01PDdqvZ1ZAQ2Gf4mcmpDYgy","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261011-092100/cholesky_claude-fable-5.1-cc-medium_mpi_r4/cholesky/cholesky.cpp","content":"#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// MPI-parallel Cholesky decomposition (right-looking, blocked algorithm)\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n//\n// Data distribution: the rows of A are distributed over the MPI ranks in a\n// 1D block-cyclic fashion with block size `b` (row block g lives on rank g % p).\n// Each rank stores its rows contiguously in row-major order (leading dim n).\n//\n// Per block column k:\n//   1. the owner of diagonal block k factors it locally and broadcasts L_kk\n//   2. every rank computes its part of the panel L_ik = A_ik * L_kk^-T\n//   3. the panel is all-gathered (transposed) so that every rank can\n//   4. update its local rows of the trailing matrix: A_ij -= L_ik * L_jk^T\n// Step 4 dominates the flop count and is perfectly parallel; the block-cyclic\n// distribution keeps the triangular trailing work balanced across ranks.\n\n#if defined(__AVX512F__)\n#define VL 8\n#elif defined(__AVX__)\n#define VL 4\n#else\n#define VL 2\n#endif\n\ntypedef double vdouble __attribute__((vector_size(VL * sizeof(double))));\n\nstatic inline vdouble vload(const double* p) {\n    vdouble v;\n    memcpy(&v, p, sizeof(v));\n    return v;\n}\n\nstatic inline void vstore(double* p, const vdouble& v) {\n    memcpy(p, &v, sizeof(v));\n}\n\nstatic constexpr size_t MAX_BLOCK = 128;\n\n// 1D block-cyclic row distribution\nstruct Layout {\n    size_t n;        // matrix size\n    size_t b;        // row block size\n    size_t p;        // number of ranks\n    size_t rank;     // my rank\n    size_t nblocks;  // number of row blocks\n    std::vector<size_t> rowsOf;  // local row count per rank\n    size_t nloc;     // my local row count\n\n    Layout(size_t n_, size_t b_, int p_, int rank_) : n(n_), b(b_), p(p_), rank(rank_) {\n        nblocks = (n + b - 1) / b;\n        rowsOf.resize(p);\n        for (size_t r = 0; r < p; ++r) {\n            size_t rows = 0;\n            for (size_t g = r; g < nblocks; g += p) rows += std::min(b, n - g * b);\n            rowsOf[r] = rows;\n        }\n        nloc = rowsOf[rank];\n    }\n\n    size_t owner(size_t gi) const { return (gi / b) % p; }\n    size_t toLocal(size_t gi) const { return ((gi / b) / p) * b + gi % b; }\n    size_t toGlobal(size_t r, size_t li) const { return ((li / b) * p + r) * b + li % b; }\n\n    // First local row index on rank r that belongs to a global block >= gblk.\n    // Returns rowsOf[r] if there is none.\n    size_t firstLocalFromBlock(size_t r, size_t gblk) const {\n        const size_t g = gblk + ((r + p - gblk % p) % p);\n        if (g >= nblocks) return rowsOf[r];\n        return (g / p) * b;\n    }\n};\n\n// Trailing update micro-kernel for R rows:\n//   rows[r][j] -= sum_k lk[r*bs + k] * PT[k*ldp + (j - jt0)]   for j in [jt0, jend)\n// PT holds the (transposed) panel: PT[k][jj] = L[jt0 + jj][kb + k]\ntemplate <int R>\nstatic void updateRows(double* const* rows, const double* lk, const size_t bs,\n                       const double* PT, const size_t ldp, const size_t jt0, const size_t jend) {\n    size_t j = jt0;\n    for (; j + 2 * VL <= jend; j += 2 * VL) {\n        vdouble acc0[R], acc1[R];\n        for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) {\n            acc0[r] = vload(rows[r] + j);\n            acc1[r] = vload(rows[r] + j + VL);\n        }\n        const double* pt = PT + (j - jt0);\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < bs; ++k, pt += ldp) {\n            const vdouble p0 = vload(pt);\n            const vdouble p1 = vload(pt + VL);\n            for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) {\n                const double l = lk[r * bs + k];\n                acc0[r] -= l * p0;\n                acc1[r] -= l * p1;\n            }\n        }\n        for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) {\n            vstore(rows[r] + j, acc0[r]);\n            vstore(rows[r] + j + VL, acc1[r]);\n        }\n    }\n    for (; j + VL <= jend; j += VL) {\n        vdouble acc[R];\n        for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) acc[r] = vload(rows[r] + j);\n        const double* pt = PT + (j - jt0);\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < bs; ++k, pt += ldp) {\n            const vdouble p0 = vload(pt);\n            for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) acc[r] -= lk[r * bs + k] * p0;\n        }\n        for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) vstore(rows[r] + j, acc[r]);\n    }\n    for (; j < jend; ++j) {\n        const double* pt = PT + (j - jt0);\n        for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) {\n            double s = rows[r][j];\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < bs; ++k) s -= lk[r * bs + k] * pt[k * ldp];\n            rows[r][j] = s;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Factor the diagonal block in place (rows `blk`, columns kb..kb+bs, leading dim n).\n// Returns the global index of the first non-positive pivot, or n on success.\nstatic size_t factorDiagonalBlock(double* blk, const size_t n, const size_t kb, const size_t bs) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < bs; ++i) {\n        double* ai = blk + i * n + kb;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {\n            const double* aj = blk + j * n + kb;\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            if (i == j) {\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) sum += aj[k] * aj[k];\n                const double val = aj[j] - sum;\n                if (val <= 0.0) return kb + j;\n                aj[j] = sqrt(val);\n            } else {\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) sum += ai[k] * aj[k];\n                ai[j] = (ai[j] - sum) / aj[j];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return n;\n}\n\n// A holds this rank's local rows (block-cyclic distribution described by `lay`).\n// On return A holds the local rows of L (upper triangle zeroed).\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const Layout& lay) {\n    const size_t n = lay.n;\n    const size_t b = lay.b;\n    const size_t p = lay.p;\n    const size_t rank = lay.rank;\n    const size_t nloc = lay.nloc;\n\n    std::vector<double> Lkk(b * b);              // broadcast diagonal block\n    std::vector<double> sendbuf(nloc * b);       // my panel rows (row-major, ld = bs)\n    std::vector<double> recvbuf(n * b);          // gathered panel rows\n    std::vector<double> PT(b * n);               // transposed panel: PT[k][j - jt0]\n    std::vector<int> counts(p), displs(p);\n    double lk[4 * MAX_BLOCK];\n\n    for (size_t kblk = 0; kblk < lay.nblocks; ++kblk) {\n        const size_t kb = kblk * b;\n        const size_t bs = std::min(b, n - kb);\n        const size_t jt0 = kb + bs;                 // first trailing column/row\n        const size_t ntrail = n - jt0;\n        const int ownerRank = (int)(kblk % p);\n\n        // 1. Factor diagonal block on its owner, broadcast it\n        int failed = 0;\n        if ((size_t)ownerRank == rank) {\n            const size_t l0 = (kblk / p) * b;\n            double* blk = A.data() + l0 * n;\n            const size_t bad = factorDiagonalBlock(blk, n, kb, bs);\n            if (bad < n) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", bad);\n                fflush(stdout);\n                failed = 1;\n            } else {\n                for (size_t i = 0; i < bs; ++i)\n                    for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) Lkk[i * bs + j] = blk[i * n + kb + j];\n            }\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(&failed, 1, MPI_INT, ownerRank, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        if (failed) return false;\n        if (ntrail == 0) break;\n        MPI_Bcast(Lkk.data(), (int)(bs * bs), MPI_DOUBLE, ownerRank, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        // 2. Panel: triangular solve for my rows below the diagonal block\n        const size_t lstart = lay.firstLocalFromBlock(rank, kblk + 1);\n        const size_t mycnt = nloc - lstart;\n        for (size_t li = lstart; li < nloc; ++li) {\n            double* a = A.data() + li * n + kb;\n            for (size_t c = 0; c < bs; ++c) {\n                const double* lc = Lkk.data() + c * bs;\n                double s = a[c];\n                for (size_t cc = 0; cc < c; ++cc) s -= a[cc] * lc[cc];\n                a[c] = s / lc[c];\n            }\n            memcpy(sendbuf.data() + (li - lstart) * bs, a, bs * sizeof(double));\n        }\n\n        // 3. All-gather the panel and transpose it into PT\n        int off = 0;\n        for (size_t r = 0; r < p; ++r) {\n            const size_t cnt = lay.rowsOf[r] - lay.firstLocalFromBlock(r, kblk + 1);\n            counts[r] = (int)(cnt * bs);\n            displs[r] = off;\n            off += counts[r];\n        }\n        MPI_Allgatherv(sendbuf.data(), (int)(mycnt * bs), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                       recvbuf.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        for (size_t r = 0; r < p; ++r) {\n            const size_t first = lay.firstLocalFromBlock(r, kblk + 1);\n            const size_t cnt = lay.rowsOf[r] - first;\n            const double* src = recvbuf.data() + displs[r];\n            for (size_t t = 0; t < cnt; ++t) {\n                const size_t col = lay.toGlobal(r, first + t) - jt0;\n                for (size_t c = 0; c < bs; ++c) PT[c * ntrail + col] = src[t * bs + c];\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 4. Trailing update of my rows: A_ij -= L_ik * L_jk^T  (j <= i)\n        // Rows are processed in groups of up to 4; a group is updated up to the\n        // diagonal of its last row, which may touch a few strictly-upper entries\n        // of the earlier rows in the group. Those are never read and are zeroed\n        // at the end.\n        size_t li = lstart;\n        while (li < nloc) {\n            const size_t R = std::min<size_t>(4, nloc - li);\n            double* rows[4];\n            for (size_t r = 0; r < R; ++r) {\n                rows[r] = A.data() + (li + r) * n;\n                memcpy(lk + r * bs, rows[r] + kb, bs * sizeof(double));\n            }\n            const size_t jend = lay.toGlobal(rank, li + R - 1) + 1;\n            switch (R) {\n                case 4: updateRows<4>(rows, lk, bs, PT.data(), ntrail, jt0, jend); break;\n                case 3: updateRows<3>(rows, lk, bs, PT.data(), ntrail, jt0, jend); break;\n                case 2: updateRows<2>(rows, lk, bs, PT.data(), ntrail, jt0, jend); break;\n                default: updateRows<1>(rows, lk, bs, PT.data(), ntrail, jt0, jend); break;\n            }\n            li += R;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Zero out upper triangular part\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < nloc; ++li) {\n        const size_t gi = lay.toGlobal(rank, li);\n        std::fill(A.begin() + li * n + gi + 1, A.begin() + (li + 1) * n, 0.0);\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix (local rows only)\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const Layout& lay) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n    //\n    // Every rank replays the same deterministic random stream. In a first pass\n    // it keeps only its own rows of B; in a second pass it regenerates B in row\n    // chunks and accumulates A_local = B_local * B^T.\n\n    const size_t n = lay.n;\n    const size_t nloc = lay.nloc;\n    std::vector<double> Bloc(nloc * n);\n\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    // Pass 1: generate random matrix B, keep my rows\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        if (lay.owner(i) == lay.rank) {\n            double* dst = Bloc.data() + lay.toLocal(i) * n;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) dst[k] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n        } else {\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) (void)rand_r(&seed);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Pass 2: compute A_local = B_local * B^T chunk by chunk\n    const size_t chunk = std::max<size_t>(1, std::min<size_t>(n, (1u << 21) / n));  // ~16 MB of B rows\n    std::vector<double> Bchunk(chunk * n);\n    seed = 42;\n    for (size_t j0 = 0; j0 < n; j0 += chunk) {\n        const size_t jc = std::min(chunk, n - j0);\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < jc * n; ++t) Bchunk[t] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n        for (size_t li = 0; li < nloc; ++li) {\n            const double* bi = Bloc.data() + li * n;\n            double* ai = A.data() + li * n;\n            for (size_t jj = 0; jj < jc; ++jj) {\n                const double* bj = Bchunk.data() + jj * n;\n                double sum = 0.0;\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) sum += bi[k] * bj[k];\n                ai[j0 + jj] = sum;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < nloc; ++li) {\n        A[li * n + lay.toGlobal(lay.rank, li)] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig,\n                      const Layout& lay, MPI_Datatype rowType) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix.\n    // Each rank reconstructs its own rows; the rows of L are broadcast\n    // rank by rank. Since L is lower triangular, the dot product can stop at\n    // min(i, j) without changing the result (the remaining terms are exact zeros).\n\n    const size_t n = lay.n;\n    const size_t nloc = lay.nloc;\n\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n    size_t maxRows = 0;\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < lay.p; ++r) maxRows = std::max(maxRows, lay.rowsOf[r]);\n    std::vector<double> buf(maxRows * n);\n\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < lay.p; ++r) {\n        const size_t rows = lay.rowsOf[r];\n        if (rows == 0) continue;\n        const double* Lr;\n        if (r == lay.rank) {\n            Lr = L.data();\n            MPI_Bcast(const_cast<double*>(Lr), (int)rows, rowType, (int)r, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        } else {\n            MPI_Bcast(buf.data(), (int)rows, rowType, (int)r, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n            Lr = buf.data();\n        }\n\n        for (size_t li = 0; li < nloc; ++li) {\n            const size_t gi = lay.toGlobal(lay.rank, li);\n            const double* Li = L.data() + li * n;\n            for (size_t t = 0; t < rows; ++t) {\n                const size_t gj = lay.toGlobal(r, t);\n                const double* Lj = Lr + t * n;\n                const size_t kmax = std::min(gi, gj) + 1;\n                double sum = 0.0;\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < kmax; ++k) sum += Li[k] * Lj[k];\n\n                const double orig = A_orig[li * n + gj];\n                const double error = fabs(sum - orig);\n                maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n\n                const double rel = error / (fabs(orig) + 1e-10);\n                relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    double local[2] = {maxError, relError};\n    double global[2];\n    MPI_Allreduce(local, global, 2, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    maxError = global[0];\n    relError = global[1];\n\n    if (lay.rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n        printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    }\n\n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        if (lay.rank == 0) printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Gather the distributed matrix into a full row-major matrix on rank 0\nstatic void gatherMatrix(const std::vector<double>& A, const Layout& lay, MPI_Datatype rowType,\n                         std::vector<double>& full) {\n    const size_t n = lay.n;\n    if (lay.rank == 0) {\n        full.assign(n * n, 0.0);\n        std::vector<double> tmp;\n        for (size_t r = 0; r < lay.p; ++r) {\n            const size_t rows = lay.rowsOf[r];\n            if (rows == 0) continue;\n            const double* src;\n            if (r == 0) {\n                src = A.data();\n            } else {\n                tmp.resize(rows * n);\n                MPI_Recv(tmp.data(), (int)rows, rowType, (int)r, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n                src = tmp.data();\n            }\n            for (size_t t = 0; t < rows; ++t) {\n                memcpy(full.data() + lay.toGlobal(r, t) * n, src + t * n, n * sizeof(double));\n            }\n        }\n    } else if (lay.nloc > 0) {\n        MPI_Send(A.data(), (int)lay.nloc, rowType, 0, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    }\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    int rank = 0, nprocs = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nprocs);\n\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments (all ranks see the same argv)\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n        printf(\"MPI ranks: %d\\n\", nprocs);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    // Choose the row block size: large enough for an efficient update kernel,\n    // small enough that every rank gets a reasonable share of the row blocks.\n    size_t b = (n >= 4096) ? MAX_BLOCK : 64;\n    while (b > 16 && (n + b - 1) / b < 2 * (size_t)nprocs) b /= 2;\n\n    const Layout lay(n, b, nprocs, rank);\n\n    MPI_Datatype rowType;\n    MPI_Type_contiguous((int)n, MPI_DOUBLE, &rowType);\n    MPI_Type_commit(&rowType);\n\n    // Allocate local part of the matrix\n    std::vector<double> A(lay.nloc * n);\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n\n    // Generate positive definite matrix\n    if (rank == 0) printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, lay);\n\n    if (validate) {\n        A_orig = A; // Save original for validation\n    }\n\n    // Perform Cholesky decomposition\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Computing Cholesky decomposition...\\n\");\n        fflush(stdout);\n    }\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    bool success = choleskyDecomposition(A, lay);\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n\n    if (!success) {\n        if (rank == 0) printf(\"Cholesky decomposition failed\\n\");\n        MPI_Type_free(&rowType);\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", (long)duration.count());\n\n        // Calculate GFLOPS (approximately n³/3 operations for Cholesky)\n        double ops = (double)n * n * n / 3.0;\n        double gflops = ops / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    }\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        std::vector<double> full;\n        gatherMatrix(A, lay, rowType, full);\n        if (rank == 0) print_results(full, \"CholeskyL\");\n    }\n\n    int ret = 0;\n\n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        if (rank == 0) printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        bool valid = validateCholesky(A, A_orig, lay, rowType);\n\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            if (valid) {\n                printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            } else {\n                printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            }\n        }\n        ret = valid ? 0 : 1;\n    }\n\n    MPI_Type_free(&rowType);\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return ret;\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":32,"cache_creation_input_tokens":15470,"cache_read_input_tokens":26325,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":15470},"output_tokens":33,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"459b68d1-9ea9-4c97-9d8a-8194957dec10","uuid":"e437a0fd-a0f4-4ce8-b572-2042a4eb152b","timestamp":"2026-10-30T23:53:47.159Z","request_id":"req_011CgZKa1B9oni5MtbFJcSSC"}

(file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"459b68d1-9ea9-4c97-9d8a-8194957dec10","uuid":"de13d74b-8597-4d92-9227-32d39b0d4791","timestamp":"2026-10-30T23:53:47.262Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"update","filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261011-092100/cholesky_claude-fable-5.1-cc-medium_mpi_r4/cholesky/cholesky.cpp","content":"#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// MPI-parallel Cholesky decomposition (right-looking, blocked algorithm)\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n//\n// Data distribution: the rows of A are distributed over the MPI ranks in a\n// 1D block-cyclic fashion with block size `b` (row block g lives on rank g % p).\n// Each rank stores its rows contiguously in row-major order (leading dim n).\n//\n// Per block column k:\n//   1. the owner of diagonal block k factors it locally and broadcasts L_kk\n//   2. every rank computes its part of the panel L_ik = A_ik * L_kk^-T\n//   3. the panel is all-gathered (transposed) so that every rank can\n//   4. update its local rows of the trailing matrix: A_ij -= L_ik * L_jk^T\n// Step 4 dominates the flop count and is perfectly parallel; the block-cyclic\n// distribution keeps the triangular trailing work balanced across ranks.\n\n#if defined(__AVX512F__)\n#define VL 8\n#elif defined(__AVX__)\n#define VL 4\n#else\n#define VL 2\n#endif\n\ntypedef double vdouble __attribute__((vector_size(VL * sizeof(double))));\n\nstatic inline vdouble vload(const double* p) {\n    vdouble v;\n    memcpy(&v, p, sizeof(v));\n    return v;\n}\n\nstatic inline void vstore(double* p, const vdouble& v) {\n    memcpy(p, &v, sizeof(v));\n}\n\nstatic constexpr size_t MAX_BLOCK = 128;\n\n// 1D block-cyclic row distribution\nstruct Layout {\n    size_t n;        // matrix size\n    size_t b;        // row block size\n    size_t p;        // number of ranks\n    size_t rank;     // my rank\n    size_t nblocks;  // number of row blocks\n    std::vector<size_t> rowsOf;  // local row count per rank\n    size_t nloc;     // my local row count\n\n    Layout(size_t n_, size_t b_, int p_, int rank_) : n(n_), b(b_), p(p_), rank(rank_) {\n        nblocks = (n + b - 1) / b;\n        rowsOf.resize(p);\n        for (size_t r = 0; r < p; ++r) {\n            size_t rows = 0;\n            for (size_t g = r; g < nblocks; g += p) rows += std::min(b, n - g * b);\n            rowsOf[r] = rows;\n        }\n        nloc = rowsOf[rank];\n    }\n\n    size_t owner(size_t gi) const { return (gi / b) % p; }\n    size_t toLocal(size_t gi) const { return ((gi / b) / p) * b + gi % b; }\n    size_t toGlobal(size_t r, size_t li) const { return ((li / b) * p + r) * b + li % b; }\n\n    // First local row index on rank r that belongs to a global block >= gblk.\n    // Returns rowsOf[r] if there is none.\n    size_t firstLocalFromBlock(size_t r, size_t gblk) const {\n        const size_t g = gblk + ((r + p - gblk % p) % p);\n        if (g >= nblocks) return rowsOf[r];\n        return (g / p) * b;\n    }\n};\n\n// Trailing update micro-kernel for R rows:\n//   rows[r][j] -= sum_k lk[r*bs + k] * PT[k*ldp + (j - jt0)]   for j in [jt0, jend)\n// PT holds the (transposed) panel: PT[k][jj] = L[jt0 + jj][kb + k]\ntemplate <int R>\nstatic void updateRows(double* const* rows, const double* lk, const size_t bs,\n                       const double* PT, const size_t ldp, const size_t jt0, const size_t jend) {\n    size_t j = jt0;\n    for (; j + 2 * VL <= jend; j += 2 * VL) {\n        vdouble acc0[R], acc1[R];\n        for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) {\n            acc0[r] = vload(rows[r] + j);\n            acc1[r] = vload(rows[r] + j + VL);\n        }\n        const double* pt = PT + (j - jt0);\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < bs; ++k, pt += ldp) {\n            const vdouble p0 = vload(pt);\n            const vdouble p1 = vload(pt + VL);\n            for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) {\n                const double l = lk[r * bs + k];\n                acc0[r] -= l * p0;\n                acc1[r] -= l * p1;\n            }\n        }\n        for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) {\n            vstore(rows[r] + j, acc0[r]);\n            vstore(rows[r] + j + VL, acc1[r]);\n        }\n    }\n    for (; j + VL <= jend; j += VL) {\n        vdouble acc[R];\n        for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) acc[r] = vload(rows[r] + j);\n        const double* pt = PT + (j - jt0);\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < bs; ++k, pt += ldp) {\n            const vdouble p0 = vload(pt);\n            for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) acc[r] -= lk[r * bs + k] * p0;\n        }\n        for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) vstore(rows[r] + j, acc[r]);\n    }\n    for (; j < jend; ++j) {\n        const double* pt = PT + (j - jt0);\n        for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) {\n            double s = rows[r][j];\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < bs; ++k) s -= lk[r * bs + k] * pt[k * ldp];\n            rows[r][j] = s;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Factor the diagonal block in place (rows `blk`, columns kb..kb+bs, leading dim n).\n// Returns the global index of the first non-positive pivot, or n on success.\nstatic size_t factorDiagonalBlock(double* blk, const size_t n, const size_t kb, const size_t bs) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < bs; ++i) {\n        double* ai = blk + i * n + kb;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {\n            const double* aj = blk + j * n + kb;\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            if (i == j) {\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) sum += aj[k] * aj[k];\n                const double val = aj[j] - sum;\n                if (val <= 0.0) return kb + j;\n                aj[j] = sqrt(val);\n            } else {\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) sum += ai[k] * aj[k];\n                ai[j] = (ai[j] - sum) / aj[j];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return n;\n}\n\n// A holds this rank's local rows (block-cyclic distribution described by `lay`).\n// On return A holds the local rows of L (upper triangle zeroed).\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const Layout& lay) {\n    const size_t n = lay.n;\n    const size_t b = lay.b;\n    const size_t p = lay.p;\n    const size_t rank = lay.rank;\n    const size_t nloc = lay.nloc;\n\n    std::vector<double> Lkk(b * b); <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Simple Cholesky decomposition (sequential, unblocked algorithm)\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // A is stored in row-major order\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            \n            if (i == j) {\n                // Diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[j * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                const double val = A[j * n + j] - sum;\n                if (val <= 0.0) {\n                    // Matrix is not positive definite\n                    printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n                    return false;\n                }\n                A[j * n + j] = sqrt(val);\n            } else {\n                // Off-diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[i * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                A[i * n + j] = (A[i * n + j] - sum) / A[j * n + j];\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // Zero out upper triangular part\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            A[i * n + j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n    \n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    \n    // Generate random matrix B\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n    \n    // Compute A = B * B^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];\n            }\n            A[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    \n    std::vector<double> reconstructed(n * n);\n    \n    // Compute L * L^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += L[i * n + k] * L[j * n + k];\n            }\n            reconstructed[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Compare with original\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        const double error = fabs(reconstructed[i] - A_orig[i]);\n        maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n        \n        const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i]) + 1e-10);\n        relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n    printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    \n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Allocate matrix\n    std::vector<double> A(n * n);\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n    \n    // Generate positive definite matrix\n    printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, n);\n    \n    if (validate) {\n        A_orig = A; // Save original for validation\n    }\n    \n    // Perform Cholesky decomposition\n    printf(\"Computing Cholesky decomposition...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    bool success = choleskyDecomposition(A, n);\n    \n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011CgZLKdF1NNDWf2F6U8NUd","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01JQUJbBNTRRHY1Sm6UkfSWB","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 - <<'EOF'\np='cholesky/cholesky.cpp'\ns=open(p).read()\nold_start=s.index('// 1D block-cyclic row distribution')\nold_end=s.index('// Trailing update micro-kernel')\nnew='''// 1D block-cyclic row distribution with a boustrophedon (\"snake\") block\n// assignment: row block g belongs to cycle c = g / p and is owned by rank\n// (g % p) in even cycles and rank (p - 1 - g % p) in odd cycles. Every rank\n// owns exactly one block per cycle, and over two consecutive cycles each rank\n// owns one block near the top and one near the bottom of the pair. This keeps\n// the triangular trailing update balanced across ranks (a plain cyclic layout\n// would systematically give later ranks longer rows to update).\nstruct Layout {\n    size_t n;        // matrix size\n    size_t b;        // row block size\n    size_t p;        // number of ranks\n    size_t rank;     // my rank\n    size_t nblocks;  // number of row blocks\n    std::vector<size_t> rowsOf;  // local row count per rank\n    size_t nloc;     // my local row count\n\n    Layout(size_t n_, size_t b_, int p_, int rank_) : n(n_), b(b_), p(p_), rank(rank_) {\n        nblocks = (n + b - 1) / b;\n        rowsOf.assign(p, 0);\n        for (size_t g = 0; g < nblocks; ++g) rowsOf[ownerOfBlock(g)] += std::min(b, n - g * b);\n        nloc = rowsOf[rank];\n    }\n\n    size_t ownerOfBlock(size_t g) const {\n        const size_t c = g / p, off = g % p;\n        return (c % 2 == 0) ? off : (p - 1 - off);\n    }\n    size_t blockOf(size_t r, size_t c) const {  // global block of rank r in cycle c\n        return c * p + ((c % 2 == 0) ? r : (p - 1 - r));\n    }\n\n    size_t owner(size_t gi) const { return ownerOfBlock(gi / b); }\n    size_t toLocal(size_t gi) const { return ((gi / b) / p) * b + gi % b; }\n    size_t toGlobal(size_t r, size_t li) const { return blockOf(r, li / b) * b + li % b; }\n\n    // First local row index on rank r that belongs to a global block >= gblk.\n    // Returns rowsOf[r] if there is none.\n    size_t firstLocalFromBlock(size_t r, size_t gblk) const {\n        size_t c = gblk / p;\n        if (blockOf(r, c) < gblk) ++c;\n        if (blockOf(r, c) >= nblocks) return rowsOf[r];\n        return c * b;\n    }\n};\n\n'''\ns=s[:old_start]+new+s[old_end:]\nopen(p,'w').write(s)\nEOF\ncmake --build /tmp/chol_build 2>&1 | grep -E 'error|warning|Built' && cd /tmp && for np in 1 3 8; do mpirun --oversubscribe -np $np /tmp/chol_build/cholesky -n 1000 -v -r | grep -E 'Sum|Sample\\[0\\]|rel|Validation:'; done && for b in 16 32 64 128; do for np in 16 64; do echo -n \"n=4096 np=$np b=$b: \"; CHOL_B=$b mpirun --oversubscribe --bind-to core -x CHOL_B -np $np /tmp/chol_build/cholesky -n 4096 | grep -E 'time'; done; done","description":"Switch to snake block assignment, verify correctness, re-sweep block sizes","timeout":600000},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":32,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1025,"cache_read_input_tokens":55811,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1025},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"459b68d1-9ea9-4c97-9d8a-8194957dec10","uuid":"abde84b8-e8f2-4497-8a82-cb2f504dcb88","timestamp":"2026-10-31T00:03:13.822Z","request_id":"req_011CgZLKcqTgfaiH6PHwLoou"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011CgZMUkGJfMN8a4ujhFVGW","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01GDuJpZeodwR4x1dDcLcZWJ","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261011-092100/cholesky_claude-fable-5.1-cc-medium_mpi_r4/cholesky/cholesky.cpp","content":"#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// MPI-parallel Cholesky decomposition (right-looking, blocked/tiled algorithm)\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n//\n// Data distribution: the matrix is split into b x b tiles which are distributed\n// over a Pr x Pc process grid in 2D block-cyclic fashion: tile (I, J) lives on\n// process (I % Pr, J % Pc). Each process stores its tiles contiguously\n// (row-major tile grid, row-major inside a tile). The matrix is padded with an\n// identity block up to a multiple of b, which leaves the factor unchanged.\n//\n// Per tile column k:\n//   1. the owner of tile (k,k) factors it and broadcasts L_kk down its process column\n//   2. the processes of that column compute their panel tiles L_ik = A_ik * L_kk^-T\n//   3. panel tiles are broadcast along process rows (each process gets the L_ik\n//      for its tile rows) and all-gathered along process columns (each process\n//      gets the L_jk for its tile columns)\n//   4. every process updates its trailing tiles: A_ij -= L_ik * L_jk^T\n// Step 4 dominates the flop count and is perfectly parallel; the 2D\n// distribution keeps the per-process communication volume at O(n^2 / sqrt(p)).\n\n#if defined(__AVX512F__)\n#define VL 8\n#elif defined(__AVX__)\n#define VL 4\n#else\n#define VL 2\n#endif\n\ntypedef double vdouble __attribute__((vector_size(VL * sizeof(double))));\n\nstatic inline vdouble vload(const double* p) {\n    vdouble v;\n    memcpy(&v, p, sizeof(v));\n    return v;\n}\n\nstatic inline void vstore(double* p, const vdouble& v) {\n    memcpy(p, &v, sizeof(v));\n}\n\n// Process grid and tile layout\nstruct Layout {\n    size_t n;         // matrix size\n    size_t b;         // tile size\n    size_t nblocks;   // number of tile rows/columns\n    size_t npad;      // padded matrix size (nblocks * b)\n    int p, rank;\n    int Pr, Pc;       // process grid\n    int ir, jc;       // my grid coordinates\n    size_t nLocRows;  // my number of tile rows\n    size_t nLocCols;  // my number of tile columns\n    MPI_Comm rowComm; // processes with the same ir (rank in rowComm == jc)\n    MPI_Comm colComm; // processes with the same jc (rank in colComm == ir)\n\n    Layout(size_t n_, size_t b_, int p_, int rank_) : n(n_), b(b_), p(p_), rank(rank_) {\n        nblocks = (n + b - 1) / b;\n        npad = nblocks * b;\n        // Most square grid with Pr >= Pc\n        Pc = 1;\n        for (int c = (int)std::sqrt((double)p); c >= 1; --c) {\n            if (p % c == 0) { Pc = c; break; }\n        }\n        Pr = p / Pc;\n        ir = rank / Pc;\n        jc = rank % Pc;\n        nLocRows = locRows(ir);\n        nLocCols = locCols(jc);\n        MPI_Comm_split(MPI_COMM_WORLD, ir, jc, &rowComm);\n        MPI_Comm_split(MPI_COMM_WORLD, jc, ir, &colComm);\n    }\n    ~Layout() {\n        MPI_Comm_free(&rowComm);\n        MPI_Comm_free(&colComm);\n    }\n    Layout(const Layout&) = delete;\n    Layout& operator=(const Layout&) = delete;\n\n    size_t locRows(int r) const { return ((size_t)r < nblocks) ? (nblocks - r + Pr - 1) / Pr : 0; }\n    size_t locCols(int c) const { return ((size_t)c < nblocks) ? (nblocks - c + Pc - 1) / Pc : 0; }\n    int worldRank(int r, int c) const { return r * Pc + c; }\n\n    size_t globalRow(size_t li) const { return li * Pr + ir; }  // tile row index\n    size_t globalCol(size_t lj) const { return lj * Pc + jc; }  // tile column index\n\n    // first local tile row with global tile row > k\n    size_t firstLocRowAfter(size_t k) const {\n        return ((size_t)ir <= k) ? (k - ir) / Pr + 1 : 0;\n    }\n    // first local tile row with global tile row >= J\n    size_t firstLocRowAtOrAfter(size_t J) const {\n        return ((size_t)ir < J) ? (J - ir + Pr - 1) / Pr : 0;\n    }\n    size_t firstLocColAfter(size_t k) const {\n        return ((size_t)jc <= k) ? (k - jc) / Pc + 1 : 0;\n    }\n\n    size_t tileOffset(size_t li, size_t lj) const { return (li * nLocCols + lj) * b * b; }\n};\n\n// Tile update micro-kernel for R rows of a tile:\n//   rows[r][j] -= sum_k lk[r*b + k] * BT[k*b + j]   for j in [0, b)\n// BT is the transposed L_jk tile: BT[k][j] = L_jk[j][k]\ntemplate <int R>\nstatic void updateRows(double* const* rows, const double* lk, const double* BT, const size_t b) {\n    size_t j = 0;\n    for (; j + 2 * VL <= b; j += 2 * VL) {\n        vdouble acc0[R], acc1[R];\n        for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) {\n            acc0[r] = vload(rows[r] + j);\n            acc1[r] = vload(rows[r] + j + VL);\n        }\n        const double* pt = BT + j;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < b; ++k, pt += b) {\n            const vdouble p0 = vload(pt);\n            const vdouble p1 = vload(pt + VL);\n            for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) {\n                const double l = lk[r * b + k];\n                acc0[r] -= l * p0;\n                acc1[r] -= l * p1;\n            }\n        }\n        for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) {\n            vstore(rows[r] + j, acc0[r]);\n            vstore(rows[r] + j + VL, acc1[r]);\n        }\n    }\n    for (; j + VL <= b; j += VL) {\n        vdouble acc[R];\n        for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) acc[r] = vload(rows[r] + j);\n        const double* pt = BT + j;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < b; ++k, pt += b) {\n            const vdouble p0 = vload(pt);\n            for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) acc[r] -= lk[r * b + k] * p0;\n        }\n        for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) vstore(rows[r] + j, acc[r]);\n    }\n    for (; j < b; ++j) {\n        for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) {\n            double s = rows[r][j];\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < b; ++k) s -= lk[r * b + k] * BT[k * b + j];\n            rows[r][j] = s;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// C -= A * B^T for b x b tiles, where BT already holds B transposed.\nstatic void tileUpdate(double* C, const double* A, const double* BT, const size_t b) {\n    size_t r0 = 0;\n    for (; r0 + 4 <= b; r0 += 4) {\n        double* rows[4] = {C + r0 * b, C + (r0 + 1) * b, C + (r0 + 2) * b, C + (r0 + 3) * b};\n        updateRows<4>(rows, A + r0 * b, BT, b);\n    }\n    for (; r0 < b; ++r0) {\n        double* rows[1] = {C + r0 * b};\n        updateRows<1>(rows, A + r0 * b, BT, b);\n    }\n}\n\nstatic void transposeTile(const double* T, double* TT, const size_t b) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < b; ++i)\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < b; ++j) TT[j * b + i] = T[i * b + j];\n}\n\n// Factor the diagonal tile in place (lower triangle). Returns the index of the\n// first non-positive pivot within the tile, or b on success.\nstatic size_t factorDiagonalTile(double* T, const size_t b) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < b; ++i) {\n        double* ai = T + i * b;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {\n            double* aj = T + j * b;\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            if (i == j) {\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) sum += aj[k] * aj[k];\n                const double val = aj[j] - sum;\n                if (val <= 0.0) return j;\n                aj[j] = sqrt(val);\n            } else {\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) sum += ai[k] * aj[k];\n                ai[j] = (ai[j] - sum) / aj[j];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return b;\n}\n\n// Solve T := T * Lkk^-T in place for a b x b tile (Lkk lower triangular).\n// Works on the transposed tile so that the inner loops are contiguous axpys.\nstatic void trsmTile(double* T, const double* Lkk, const size_t b, double* tmp) {\n    transposeTile(T, tmp, b);  // tmp[c][r] = T[r][c]\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < b; ++c) {\n        double* tc = tmp + c * b;\n        const double d = Lkk[c * b + c];\n        for (size_t r = 0; r < b; ++r) tc[r] /= d;\n        for (size_t c2 = c + 1; {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011CgZMs3dh4siMNxtxzkwtA","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_0117tXE48Zk5ALqkVT7Ecyhp","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261011-092100/cholesky_claude-fable-5.1-cc-medium_mpi_r4/cholesky/cholesky.cpp","content":"#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// MPI-parallel Cholesky decomposition (right-looking, blocked/tiled algorithm)\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n//\n// Data distribution: the matrix is split into b x b tiles which are distributed\n// over a Pr x Pc process grid in 2D block-cyclic fashion: tile (I, J) lives on\n// process (I % Pr, J % Pc). Each process stores its tiles contiguously\n// (row-major tile grid, row-major inside a tile). The matrix is padded with an\n// identity block up to a multiple of b, which leaves the factor unchanged.\n//\n// Per tile column k:\n//   1. the owner of tile (k,k) factors it and broadcasts L_kk down its process column\n//   2. the processes of that column compute their panel tiles L_ik = A_ik * L_kk^-T\n//   3. panel tiles are broadcast along process rows (each process gets the L_ik\n//      for its tile rows) and all-gathered along process columns (each process\n//      gets the L_jk for its tile columns)\n//   4. every process updates its trailing tiles: A_ij -= L_ik * L_jk^T\n// Step 4 dominates the flop count and is perfectly parallel; the 2D\n// distribution keeps the per-process communication volume at O(n^2 / sqrt(p)).\n\n#if defined(__AVX512F__)\n#define VL 8\n#elif defined(__AVX__)\n#define VL 4\n#else\n#define VL 2\n#endif\n\ntypedef double vdouble __attribute__((vector_size(VL * sizeof(double))));\n\nstatic inline vdouble vload(const double* p) {\n    vdouble v;\n    memcpy(&v, p, sizeof(v));\n    return v;\n}\n\nstatic inline void vstore(double* p, const vdouble& v) {\n    memcpy(p, &v, sizeof(v));\n}\n\n// Process grid and tile layout\nstruct Layout {\n    size_t n;         // matrix size\n    size_t b;         // tile size\n    size_t nblocks;   // number of tile rows/columns\n    size_t npad;      // padded matrix size (nblocks * b)\n    int p, rank;\n    int Pr, Pc;       // process grid\n    int ir, jc;       // my grid coordinates\n    size_t nLocRows;  // my number of tile rows\n    size_t nLocCols;  // my number of tile columns\n    MPI_Comm rowComm; // processes with the same ir (rank in rowComm == jc)\n    MPI_Comm colComm; // processes with the same jc (rank in colComm == ir)\n\n    Layout(size_t n_, size_t b_, int p_, int rank_) : n(n_), b(b_), p(p_), rank(rank_) {\n        nblocks = (n + b - 1) / b;\n        npad = nblocks * b;\n        // Most square grid with Pr >= Pc\n        Pc = 1;\n        for (int c = (int)std::sqrt((double)p); c >= 1; --c) {\n            if (p % c == 0) { Pc = c; break; }\n        }\n        Pr = p / Pc;\n        ir = rank / Pc;\n        jc = rank % Pc;\n        nLocRows = locRows(ir);\n        nLocCols = locCols(jc);\n        MPI_Comm_split(MPI_COMM_WORLD, ir, jc, &rowComm);\n        MPI_Comm_split(MPI_COMM_WORLD, jc, ir, &colComm);\n    }\n    ~Layout() {\n        MPI_Comm_free(&rowComm);\n        MPI_Comm_free(&colComm);\n    }\n    Layout(const Layout&) = delete;\n    Layout& operator=(const Layout&) = delete;\n\n    size_t locRows(int r) const { return ((size_t)r < nblocks) ? (nblocks - r + Pr - 1) / Pr : 0; }\n    size_t locCols(int c) const { return ((size_t)c < nblocks) ? (nblocks - c + Pc - 1) / Pc : 0; }\n    int worldRank(int r, int c) const { return r * Pc + c; }\n\n    size_t globalRow(size_t li) const { return li * Pr + ir; }  // tile row index\n    size_t globalCol(size_t lj) const { return lj * Pc + jc; }  // tile column index\n\n    // first local tile row with global tile row > k\n    size_t firstLocRowAfter(size_t k) const {\n        return ((size_t)ir <= k) ? (k - ir) / Pr + 1 : 0;\n    }\n    // first local tile row with global tile row >= J\n    size_t firstLocRowAtOrAfter(size_t J) const {\n        return ((size_t)ir < J) ? (J - ir + Pr - 1) / Pr : 0;\n    }\n    size_t firstLocColAfter(size_t k) const {\n        return ((size_t)jc <= k) ? (k - jc) / Pc + 1 : 0;\n    }\n\n    size_t tileOffset(size_t li, size_t lj) const { return (li * nLocCols + lj) * b * b; }\n};\n\n// Tile update micro-kernel for R rows of a tile:\n//   rows[r][j] -= sum_k lk[r*b + k] * BT[k*b + j]   for j in [0, b)\n// BT is the transposed L_jk tile: BT[k][j] = L_jk[j][k]\ntemplate <int R>\nstatic void updateRows(double* const* rows, const double* lk, const double* BT, const size_t b) {\n    size_t j = 0;\n    for (; j + 2 * VL <= b; j += 2 * VL) {\n        vdouble acc0[R], acc1[R];\n        for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) {\n            acc0[r] = vload(rows[r] + j);\n            acc1[r] = vload(rows[r] + j + VL);\n        }\n        const double* pt = BT + j;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < b; ++k, pt += b) {\n            const vdouble p0 = vload(pt);\n            const vdouble p1 = vload(pt + VL);\n            for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) {\n                const double l = lk[r * b + k];\n                acc0[r] -= l * p0;\n                acc1[r] -= l * p1;\n            }\n        }\n        for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) {\n            vstore(rows[r] + j, acc0[r]);\n            vstore(rows[r] + j + VL, acc1[r]);\n        }\n    }\n    for (; j + VL <= b; j += VL) {\n        vdouble acc[R];\n        for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) acc[r] = vload(rows[r] + j);\n        const double* pt = BT + j;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < b; ++k, pt += b) {\n            const vdouble p0 = vload(pt);\n            for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) acc[r] -= lk[r * b + k] * p0;\n        }\n        for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) vstore(rows[r] + j, acc[r]);\n    }\n    for (; j < b; ++j) {\n        for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) {\n            double s = rows[r][j];\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < b; ++k) s -= lk[r * b + k] * BT[k * b + j];\n            rows[r][j] = s;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// C -= A * B^T for b x b tiles, where BT already holds B transposed.\nstatic void tileUpdate(double* C, const double* A, const double* BT, const size_t b) {\n    size_t r0 = 0;\n    for (; r0 + 4 <= b; r0 += 4) {\n        double* rows[4] = {C + r0 * b, C + (r0 + 1) * b, C + (r0 + 2) * b, C + (r0 + 3) * b};\n        updateRows<4>(rows, A + r0 * b, BT, b);\n    }\n    for (; r0 < b; ++r0) {\n        double* rows[1] = {C + r0 * b};\n        updateRows<1>(rows, A + r0 * b, BT, b);\n    }\n}\n\nstatic void transposeTile(const double* T, double* TT, const size_t b) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < b; ++i)\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < b; ++j) TT[j * b + i] = T[i * b + j];\n}\n\n// Factor the diagonal tile in place (lower triangle). Returns the index of the\n// first non-positive pivot within the tile, or b on success.\nstatic size_t factorDiagonalTile(double* T, const size_t b) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < b; ++i) {\n        double* ai = T + i * b;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {\n            double* aj = T + j * b;\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            if (i == j) {\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) sum += aj[k] * aj[k];\n                const double val = aj[j] - sum;\n                if (val <= 0.0) return j;\n                aj[j] = sqrt(val);\n            } else {\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) sum += ai[k] * aj[k];\n                ai[j] = (ai[j] - sum) / aj[j];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return b;\n}\n\n// Solve T := T * Lkk^-T in place for a b x b tile (Lkk lower triangular).\n// Works on the transposed tile so that the inner loops are contiguous axpys.\nstatic void trsmTile(double* T, const double* Lkk, const size_t b, double* tmp) {\n    transposeTile(T, tmp, b);  // tmp[c][r] = T[r][c]\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < b; ++c) {\n        double* tc = tmp + c * b;\n        const double d = Lkk[c * b + c];\n        for (size_t r = 0; r < b; ++r) tc[r] /= d;\n        for (size_t c2 = c + 1; c2 < b; ++c2) {\n            const double l = Lkk[c2 * b + c];\n            double* t2 = tmp + c2 * b;\n            for (size_t r = 0; r < b; ++r) t2[r] -= l * tc[r];\n        }\n    }\n    transposeTile(tmp, T, b);\n}\n\n// A holds this process's tiles (2D block-cyclic distribution described by `lay`).\n// On return A holds the local tiles of L (upper triangle zeroed).\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const Layout& lay) {\n    const size_t b = lay.b;\n    const size_t bb = b * b;\n    const size_t nb = lay.nblocks;\n    const size_t nLocRows = lay.nLocRows;\n    const size_t nLocCols = lay.nLocCols;\n\n    std::vector<double> Lkk(bb);                   // diagonal tile factor\n    std::vector<double> tmp(bb);                   // scratch for trsm\n    std::vector<double> BT(bb);                    // transposed L_jk\n    std::vector<double> rowBuf(nLocRows * bb);     // L_ik for my tile rows (i > k)\n    std::vector<double> sendBuf(nLocRows * bb);    // my contribution to the column exchange\n    std::vector<double> colBuf(nLocCols * bb);     // L_jk for my tile columns (j > k)\n    std::vector<int> counts(lay.Pr), displs(lay.Pr);\n    std::vector<size_t> posOfJ(nb);\n\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < nb; ++k) {\n        const int kr = (int)(k % lay.Pr);\n        const int kc = (int)(k % lay.Pc);\n\n        // 1. Factor diagonal tile on its owner\n        int failed = 0;\n        if (lay.ir == kr && lay.jc == kc) {\n            double* T = A.data() + lay.tileOffset(k / lay.Pr, k / lay.Pc);\n            const size_t bad = factorDiagonalTile(T, b);\n            if (bad < b) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", k * b + bad);\n                fflush(stdout);\n                failed = 1;\n            } else {\n                memcpy(Lkk.data(), T, bb * sizeof(double));\n            }\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(&failed, 1, MPI_INT, lay.worldRank(kr, kc), MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        if (failed) return false;\n        if (k + 1 == nb) break;\n\n        // 2. Panel: processes in column kc solve their tiles below the diagonal\n        const size_t liFirst = std::min(lay.firstLocRowAfter(k), nLocRows);\n        const size_t nTrailRows = nLocRows - liFirst;\n        if (lay.jc == kc) {\n            MPI_Bcast(Lkk.data(), (int)bb, MPI_DOUBLE, kr, lay.colComm);\n            const size_t lk = k / lay.Pc;\n            for (size_t li = liFirst; li < nLocRows; ++li) {\n                double* T = A.data() + lay.tileOffset(li, lk);\n                trsmTile(T, Lkk.data(), b, tmp.data());\n                memcpy(rowBuf.data() + (li - liFirst) * bb, T, bb * sizeof(double));\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 3a. Broadcast panel tiles along process rows\n        MPI_Bcast(rowBuf.data(), (int)(nTrailRows * bb), MPI_DOUBLE, kc, lay.rowComm);\n\n        // 3b. All-gather along process columns the L_jk for tile columns j owned by\n        //     this process column. Process row r contributes tiles j > k with\n        //     j % Pr == r and j % Pc == jc, in increasing order of j.\n        {\n            size_t pos = 0;\n            for (int r = 0; r < lay.Pr; ++r) {\n                displs[r] = (int)(pos * bb);\n                size_t cnt = 0;\n                size_t J = ((size_t)r <= k) ? ((k - r) / lay.Pr + 1) * lay.Pr + r : (size_t)r;\n                for (; J < nb; J += lay.Pr) {\n                    if ((int)(J % lay.Pc) == lay.jc) {\n                        posOfJ[J] = pos + cnt;\n                        ++cnt;\n                    }\n                }\n                counts[r] = (int)(cnt * bb);\n                pos += cnt;\n            }\n            size_t mine = 0;\n            for (size_t li = liFirst; li < nLocRows; ++li) {\n                if ((int)(lay.globalRow(li) % lay.Pc) == lay.jc) {\n                    memcpy(sendBuf.data() + mine * bb, rowBuf.data() + (li - liFirst) * bb, bb * sizeof(double));\n                    ++mine;\n                }\n            }\n            MPI_Allgatherv(sendBuf.data(), (int)(mine * bb), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                           colBuf.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, lay.colComm);\n        }\n\n        // 4. Trailing update of my tiles: A_ij -= L_ik * L_jk^T for i >= j > k.\n        //    Diagonal tiles are updated in full; their strictly upper part is\n        //    never read and is zeroed at the end.\n        for (size_t lj = lay.firstLocColAfter(k); lj < nLocCols; ++lj) {\n            const size_t J = lay.globalCol(lj);\n            transposeTile(colBuf.data() + posOfJ[J] * bb, BT.data(), b);\n            for (size_t li = lay.firstLocRowAtOrAfter(J); li < nLocRows; ++li) {\n                tileUpdate(A.data() + lay.tileOffset(li, lj), rowBuf.data() + (li - liFirst) * bb, BT.data(), b);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Zero out upper triangular part\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < nLocRows; ++li) {\n        const size_t I = lay.globalRow(li);\n        for (size_t lj = 0; lj < nLocCols; ++lj) {\n            const size_t J = lay.globalCol(lj);\n            double* T = A.data() + lay.tileOffset(li, lj);\n            if (I < J) {\n                std::fill(T, T + bb, 0.0);\n            } else if (I == J) {\n                for (size_t i = 0; i < b; ++i) std::fill(T + i * b + i + 1, T + (i + 1) * b, 0.0);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix (local tiles only)\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const Layout& lay) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n    //\n    // Every process replays the same deterministic random stream and keeps the\n    // rows of B it needs: those of its tile rows and those of its tile columns.\n    // Only the lower triangle (plus diagonal tiles) is generated; the strictly\n    // upper tiles are never read by the factorization. Padding rows/columns\n    // beyond n get an identity block.\n\n    const size_t n = lay.n;\n    const size_t b = lay.b;\n    const size_t nLocRows = lay.nLocRows;\n    const size_t nLocCols = lay.nLocCols;\n\n    std::vector<double> Brow(nLocRows * b * n);\n    std::vector<double> Bcol(nLocCols * b * n);\n    std::vector<double> line(n);\n\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    // Generate random matrix B, keep the rows I need\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) line[k] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n        const size_t I = i / b;\n        if ((int)(I % lay.Pr) == lay.ir) {\n            memcpy(Brow.data() + ((I / lay.Pr) * b + i % b) * n, line.data(), n * sizeof(double));\n        }\n        if ((int)(I % lay.Pc) == lay.jc) {\n            memcpy(Bcol.data() + ((I / lay.Pc) * b + i % b) * n, line.data(), n * sizeof(double));\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Compute my tiles of A = B * B^T (lower triangle incl. diagonal tiles)\n    std::fill(A.begin(), A.end(), 0.0);\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < nLocRows; ++li) {\n        const size_t I = lay.globalRow(li);\n        for (size_t lj = 0; lj < nLocCols; ++lj) {\n            const size_t J = lay.globalCol(lj);\n            if (J > I) continue;\n            double* T = A.data() + lay.tileOffset(li, lj);\n            for (size_t r = 0; r < b; ++r) {\n                const size_t gi = I * b + r;\n                const double* bi = Brow.data() + (li * b + r) * n;\n                for (size_t c = 0; c < b; ++c) {\n                    const size_t gj = J * b + c;\n                    if (gi >= n || gj >= n) {\n                        T[r * b + c] = (gi == gj) ? 1.0 : 0.0;\n                        continue;\n                    }\n                    const double* bj = Bcol.data() + (lj * b + c) * n;\n                    double sum = 0.0;\n                    for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) sum += bi[k] * bj[k];\n                    T[r * b + c] = sum;\n                }\n            }\n            // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n            if (I == J) {\n                for (size_t r = 0; r < b && I * b + r < n; ++r) T[r * b + r] += n;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const Layout& lay) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix.\n    // Each process checks its lower-triangle tiles. For that it needs the full\n    // tile rows of L for its tile rows (gathered along the process row) and\n    // for its tile columns (gathered along the process column). Since both\n    // L * L^T and A are exactly symmetric, checking the lower triangle yields\n    // the same maximum errors as checking the full matrix. L is lower\n    // triangular, so each dot product can stop at min(i, j) without changing\n    // the result.\n\n    const size_t n = lay.n;\n    const size_t b = lay.b;\n    const size_t bb = b * b;\n    const size_t nb = lay.nblocks;\n    const size_t npad = lay.npad;\n    const size_t nLocRows = lay.nLocRows;\n    const size_t nLocCols = lay.nLocCols;\n\n    // Phase 1: full tile rows of L for my tile rows (row-major, ld = npad)\n    std::vector<double> Lrows(nLocRows * b * npad);\n    {\n        std::vector<int> counts(lay.Pc), displs(lay.Pc);\n        for (int c = 0; c < lay.Pc; ++c) {\n            counts[c] = (int)(nLocRows * lay.locCols(c) * bb);\n            displs[c] = (c == 0) ? 0 : displs[c - 1] + counts[c - 1];\n        }\n        std::vector<double> recv(nLocRows * nb * bb);\n        MPI_Allgatherv(L.data(), (int)(nLocRows * nLocCols * bb), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                       recv.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, lay.rowComm);\n        for (int c = 0; c < lay.Pc; ++c) {\n            const size_t ncols = lay.locCols(c);\n            const double* src = recv.data() + displs[c];\n            for (size_t li = 0; li < nLocRows; ++li) {\n                for (size_t lj = 0; lj < ncols; ++lj) {\n                    const size_t J = lj * lay.Pc + c;\n                    const double* T = src + (li * ncols + lj) * bb;\n                    for (size_t r = 0; r < b; ++r) {\n                        memcpy(Lrows.data() + (li * b + r) * npad + J * b, T + r * b, b * sizeof(double));\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Phase 2: full tile rows of L for my tile columns, gathered along the\n    // process column. Process row r contributes tile rows J with J % Pr == r\n    // and J % Pc == jc.\n    std::vector<double> Lcols(nLocCols * b * npad);\n    std::vector<size_t> posOfJ(nb);\n    {\n        std::vector<int> counts(lay.Pr), displs(lay.Pr);\n        size_t pos = 0;\n        for (int r = 0; r < lay.Pr; ++r) {\n            displs[r] = (int)(pos * b * npad);\n            size_t cnt = 0;\n            for (size_t J = r; J < nb; J += lay.Pr) {\n                if ((int)(J % lay.Pc) == lay.jc) posOfJ[J] = pos + cnt++;\n            }\n            counts[r] = (int)(cnt * b * npad);\n            pos += cnt;\n        }\n        std::vector<double> send;\n        for (size_t li = 0; li < nLocRows; ++li) {\n            if ((int)(lay.globalRow(li) % lay.Pc) == lay.jc) {\n                send.insert(send.end(), Lrows.begin() + li * b * npad, Lrows.begin() + (li + 1) * b * npad);\n            }\n        }\n        MPI_Allgatherv(send.data(), (int)send.size(), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                       Lcols.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, lay.colComm);\n    }\n\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < nLocRows; ++li) {\n        const size_t I = lay.globalRow(li);\n        for (size_t lj = 0; lj < nLocCols; ++lj) {\n            const size_t J = lay.globalCol(lj);\n            if (J > I) continue;\n            const double* T = A_orig.data() + lay.tileOffset(li, lj);\n            const double* Lj0 = Lcols.data() + posOfJ[J] * b * npad;\n            for (size_t r = 0; r < b; ++r) {\n                const size_t gi = I * b + r;\n                if (gi >= n) break;\n                const double* Li = Lrows.data() + (li * b + r) * npad;\n                const size_t cmax = (I == J) ? r + 1 : b;\n                for Each process stores its tiles contiguously\n// (row-major tile grid, row-major inside a tile). The matrix is padded with an\n// identity block up to a multiple of b, which leaves the factor unchanged.\n//\n// Per tile column k:\n//   1. the owner of tile (k,k) factors it and broadcasts L_kk down its process column\n//   2. the processes of that column compute their panel tiles L_ik = A_ik * L_kk^-T\n//   3. panel tiles are broadcast along process rows (each process gets the L_ik\n//      for its tile rows) and all-gathered along process columns (each process\n//      gets the L_jk for its tile columns)\n//   4. every process updates its trailing tiles: A_ij -= L_ik * L_jk^T\n// Step 4 dominates the flop count and is perfectly parallel; the 2D\n// distribution keeps the per-process communication volume at O(n^2 / sqrt(p)).\n\n#if defined(__AVX512F__)\n#define VL 8\n#elif defined(__AVX__)\n#define VL 4\n#else\n#define VL 2\n#endif\n\ntypedef double vdouble __attribute__((vector_size(VL * sizeof(double))));\n\nstatic inline vdouble vload(const double* p) {\n    vdouble v;\n    memcpy(&v, p, sizeof(v));\n    return v;\n}\n\nstatic inline void vstore(double* p, const vdouble& v) {\n    memcpy(p, &v, sizeof(v));\n}\n\n// Process grid and tile layout\nstruct Layout {\n    size_t n;         // matrix size\n    size_t b;         // tile size\n    size_t nblocks;   // number of tile rows/columns\n    size_t npad;      // padded matrix size (nblocks * b)\n    int p, rank;\n    int Pr, Pc;       // process grid\n    int ir, jc;       // my grid coordinates\n    size_t nLocRows;  // my number of tile rows\n    size_t nLocCols;  // my number of tile columns\n    MPI_Comm rowComm; // processes with the same ir (rank in rowComm == jc)\n    MPI_Comm colComm; // processes with the same jc (rank in colComm == ir)\n\n    Layout(size_t n_, size_t b_, int p_, int rank_) : n(n_), b(b_), p(p_), rank(rank_) {\n        nblocks = (n + b - 1) / b;\n        npad = nblocks * b;\n        // Most square grid with Pr >= Pc\n        Pc = 1;\n        for (int c = (int)std::sqrt((double)p); c >= 1; --c) {\n            if (p % c == 0) { Pc = c; break; }\n        }\n        Pr = p / Pc;\n        ir = rank / Pc;\n        jc = rank % Pc;\n        nLocRows = locRows(ir);\n        nLocCols = locCols(jc);\n        MPI_Comm_split(MPI_COMM_WORLD, ir, jc, &rowComm);\n        MPI_Comm_split(MPI_COMM_WORLD, jc, ir, &colComm);\n    }\n    ~Layout() {\n        MPI_Comm_free(&rowComm);\n        MPI_Comm_free(&colComm);\n    }\n    Layout(const Layout&) = delete;\n    Layout& operator=(const Layout&) = delete;\n\n    size_t locRows(int r) const { return ((size_t)r < nblocks) ? (nblocks - r + Pr - 1) / Pr : 0; }\n    size_t locCols(int c) const { return ((size_t)c < nblocks) ? (nblocks - c + Pc - 1) / Pc : 0; }\n    int worldRank(int r, int c) const { return r * Pc + c; }\n\n    size_t globalRow(size_t li) const { return li * Pr + ir; }  // tile row index\n    size_t globalCol(size_t lj) const { return lj * Pc + jc; }  // tile column index\n\n    // first local tile row with global tile row > k\n    size_t firstLocRowAfter(size_t k) const {\n        return ((size_t)ir <= k) ? (k - ir) / Pr + 1 : 0;\n    }\n    // first local tile row with global tile row >= J\n    size_t firstLocRowAtOrAfter(size_t J) const {\n        return ((size_t)ir < J) ? (J - ir + Pr - 1) / Pr : 0;\n    }\n    size_t firstLocColAfter(size_t k) const {\n        return ((size_t)jc <= k) ? (k - jc) / Pc + 1 : 0;\n    }\n\n    size_t tileOffset(size_t li, size_t lj) const { return (li * nLocCols + lj) * b * b; }\n};\n\n// Tile update micro-kernel for R rows of a tile:\n//   rows[r][j] -= sum_k lk[r*b + k] * BT[k*b + j]   for j in [0, b)\n// BT is the transposed L_jk tile: BT[k][j] = L_jk[j][k]\ntemplate <int R>\nstatic void updateRows(double* const* rows, const double* lk, const double* BT, const size_t b) {\n    size_t j = 0;\n    for (; j + 2 * VL <= b; j += 2 * VL) {\n        vdouble acc0[R], acc1[R];\n        for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) {\n            acc0[r] = vload(rows[r] + j);\n            acc1[r] = vload(rows[r] + j + VL);\n        }\n        const double* pt = BT + j;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < b; ++k, pt += b) {\n            const vdouble p0 = vload(pt);\n            const vdouble p1 = vload(pt + VL);\n            for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) {\n                const double l = lk[r * b + k];\n                acc0[r] -= l * p0;\n                acc1[r] -= l * p1;\n            }\n        }\n        for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) {\n            vstore(rows[r] + j, acc0[r]);\n            vstore(rows[r] + j + VL, acc1[r]);\n        }\n    }\n    for (; j + VL <= b; j += VL) {\n        vdouble acc[R];\n        for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) acc[r] = vload(rows[r] + j);\n        const double* pt = BT + j;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < b; ++k, pt += b) {\n            const vdouble p0 = vload(pt);\n            for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) acc[r] -= lk[r * b + k] * p0;\n        }\n        for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) vstore(rows[r] + j, acc[r]);\n    }\n    for (; j < b; ++j) {\n        for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) {\n            double s = rows[r][j];\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < b; ++k) s -= lk[r * b + k] * BT[k * b + j];\n            rows[r][j] = s;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// C -= A * B^T for b x b tiles, where BT already holds B transposed.\nstatic void tileUpdate(double* C, const double* A, const double* BT, const size_t b) {\n    size_t r0 = 0;\n    for (; r0 + 4 <= b; r0 += 4) {\n        double* rows[4] = {C + r0 * b, C + (r0 + 1) * b, C + (r0 + 2) * b, C + (r0 + 3) * b};\n        updateRows<4>(rows, A + r0 * b, BT, b);\n    }\n    for (; r0 < b; ++r0) {\n        double* rows[1] = {C + r0 * b};\n        updateRows<1>(rows, A + r0 * b, BT, b);\n    }\n}\n\nstatic void transposeTile(const double* T, double* TT, const size_t b) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < b; ++i)\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < b; ++j) TT[j * b + i] = T[i * b + j];\n}\n\n// Factor the diagonal tile in place (lower triangle). Returns the index of the\n// first non-positive pivot within the tile, or b on success.\nstatic size_t factorDiagonalTile(double* T, const size_t b) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < b; ++i) {\n        double* ai = T + i * b;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {\n            double* aj = T + j * b;\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            if (i == j) {\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) sum += aj[k] * aj[k];\n                const double val = aj[j] - sum;\n                if (val <= 0.0) return j;\n                aj[j] = sqrt(val);\n            } else {\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) sum += ai[k] * aj[k];\n                ai[j] = (ai[j] - sum) / aj[j];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return b;\n}\n\n// Solve T := T * Lkk^-T in place for a b x b tile (Lkk lower triangular).\n// Works on the transposed tile so that the inner loops are contiguous axpys.\nstatic void trsmTile(double* T, const double* Lkk, const size_t b, double* tmp) {\n    transposeTile(T, tmp, b);  // tmp[c][r] = T[r][c]\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < b; ++c) {\n        double* tc = tmp + c * b;\n        const double d = Lkk[c * b + c];\n        for (size_t r = 0; r < b; ++r) tc[r] /= d;\n        for (size_t c2 = c + 1; c2 < b; ++c2) {\n            const double l = Lkk[c2 * b + c];\n            double* t2 = tmp + c2 * b;\n            for (size_t r = 0; r < b; ++r) t2[r] -= l * tc[r];\n        }\n    }\n    transposeTile(tmp, T, b);\n}\n\n// A holds this process's tiles (2D block-cyclic distribution described by `lay`).\n// On return A holds the local tiles of L (upper triangle zeroed).\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const Layout& lay) {\n    const size_t b = lay.b;\n    const size_t bb = b * b;\n    const size_t nb = lay.nblocks;\n    const size_t nLocRows = lay.nLocRows;\n    const size_t nLocCols = lay.nLocCols;\n\n    std::vector<double> Lkk(bb);                   // diagonal tile factor\n    std::vector<double> tmp(bb);                   // scratch for trsm\n    std::vector<double> BT(bb);                    // transposed L_jk\n    std::vector<double> rowBuf(nLocRows * bb);     // L_ik for my tile rows (i > k)\n    std::vector<double> sendBuf(nLocRows * bb);    // my contribution to the column exchange\n    std::vector<double> colBuf(nLocCols * bb);     // L_jk for my tile columns (j > k)\n    std::vector<int> counts(lay.Pr), displs(lay.Pr);\n    std::vector<size_t> posOfJ(nb);\n\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < nb; ++k) {\n        const int kr = (int)(k % lay.Pr);\n        const int kc = (int)(k % lay.Pc);\n\n        // 1. Factor diagonal tile on its owner\n        int failed = 0;\n        if (lay.ir == kr && lay.jc == kc) {\n            double* T = A.data() + lay.tileOffset(k / lay.Pr, k / lay.Pc);\n            const size_t bad = factorDiagonalTile(T, b);\n            if (bad < b) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", k * b + bad);\n                fflush(stdout);\n                failed = 1;\n            } else {\n                memcpy(Lkk.data(), T, bb * sizeof(double));\n            }\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(&failed, 1, MPI_INT, lay.worldRank(kr, kc), MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        if (failed) return false;\n        if (k + 1 == nb) break;\n\n        // 2. Panel: processes in column kc solve their tiles below the diagonal\n        const size_t liFirst = std::min(lay.firstLocRowAfter(k), nLocRows);\n        const size_t nTrailRows = nLocRows - liFirst;\n        if (lay.jc == kc) {\n            MPI_Bcast(Lkk.data(), (int)bb, MPI_DOUBLE, kr, lay.colComm);\n            const size_t lk = k / lay.Pc;\n            for (size_t li = liFirst; li < nLocRows; ++li) {\n                double* T = A.data() + lay.tileOffset(li, lk);\n                trsmTile(T, Lkk.data(), b, tmp.data());\n                memcpy(rowBuf.data() + (li - liFirst) * bb, T, bb * sizeof(double));\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 3a. Broadcast panel tiles along process rows\n        MPI_Bcast(rowBuf.data(), (int)(nTrailRows * bb), MPI_DOUBLE, kc, lay.rowComm);\n\n        // 3b. All-gather along process columns the L_jk for tile columns j owned by\n        //     this process column. Process row r contributes tiles j > k with\n        //     j % Pr == r and j % Pc == jc, in increasing order of j.\n        {\n            size_t pos = 0;\n            for (int r = 0; r < lay.Pr; ++r) {\n                displs[r] = (int)(pos * bb);\n                size_t cnt = 0;\n                size_t J = ((size_t)r <= k) ?
